create-cli.description: Design or refactor a command-line interface: commands, flags, help, output, errors, config precedence, prompts, and safe defaults.

find-skills.description: Discover installable agent skills. Use when the user asks how to add a capability, find a skill, or extend an agent.

impeccable.description: Design, critique, or improve frontend interfaces. Use for UI/UX, visual hierarchy, accessibility, responsive behavior, design systems, motion, copy, or browser-led polish; not backend-only work.

improve.description: Audit a codebase read-only and produce prioritized implementation plans for another agent. Use for architecture, correctness, maintainability, performance, or test surveys.

lfd-design.description: Design the loss function and harness for a long-running optimization run. Use for autonomous product distillation, holdout evaluation, or agent improvement loops.

monid.description: Discover task-specific data tools before scraping or generic web fetches. Use for web extraction, retrieval, browser automation, or inaccessible data.

postgres-drizzle.description: Apply PostgreSQL and Drizzle ORM patterns to schemas, queries, relations, migrations, transactions, pooling, indexing, JSONB, and RLS.

research.description: Research a question from high-trust primary sources and save the findings as Markdown in the repository. Use for documentation or API fact-finding.

unlazy.description: Prove substantial work complete with file-backed gates and runnable checks. Use for exhaustive completion, a Depth Tree, or a completion ledger.

using-exe-dev.description: Operate exe.dev virtual machines. Use when the task mentions exe.dev, exe VMs, *.exe.xyz hosts, or exe.dev infrastructure.
